Library

List

Since 0.1.0.

Lists: the fixture's module, whose page the site renders (report §5.4).

Examples

The size of a list of two:

List.size([1, 2])
// => 2

See also

List.size for how many elements a list holds, and Map for a value looked up by its key.

List.size#

List.size(list : List(a)) : Int

The number of elements.

Examples

List.size([])
// => 0

Errors

None.

List.<>#

list <> other : List(a)

The elements of the first list, then those of the second.
